codeReview.summary: The redesign replaced the legacy filters card with a cleaner filter bar, added field-specific search submission, status popover selection, dropdowns, and URL synchronization. However, the delivered dropdown option lists did not actually cover the known in-product template/email values already present elsewhere in the email-delivery and queue flows, so the feature did not fully satisfy the requirement that operators can filter by known values without regressions.

issues.description: The hardcoded template and email type dropdown options omit known values already used by the product, including `request_received`, `confirmation`, `booking_rejected`, and `restaurant_cancellation`. Those values are referenced in the queue panel and dev/mock delivery flows, so operators could not select existing records by these values from the redesigned filter UI even though the backend and URL params support them.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The repo already had known email/template values in queue and mock delivery flows, but `.factory/library/architecture.md` did not capture that the delivery-log filter dropdowns should stay aligned with those shared enums/labels. This omission likely contributed to the worker hardcoding an incomplete subset.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `src/components/features/email-delivery/components/OpsEmailQueuePanel.tsx` includes `request_received`, `confirmation`, `booking_rejected`, and `restaurant_cancellation`; `src/app/(public)/dev/_mocks/services/devEmailDelivery.ts` and `src/app/(public)/dev/_mocks/services/devBookingService.ts` also emit `booking_confirmation`. `.factory/library/architecture.md` mentions the filter bar but not the canonical option source or required value coverage.

summary: Fail: the redesigned filter bar UI works structurally, but its hardcoded template/email dropdown options were incomplete versus known in-product values, so operators could not filter some real records until a later follow-up fix expanded coverage.
